name: qwen3_5_9b/slime_sft_swe
description: SWE-Bench Verified SFT recipe: four pinned Hugging Face SWE trajectory datasets for Qwen3.5-9B-Base.

validation.description: Validate on the first 150 samples of swe-bench-verified in dataset order; the remaining 350 are held out. Baseline: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base measured by the grading service on the same 150, mounted read-only at $HOME/grading_baseline. The official evaluation runs the held-out remainder only, so its accuracy is the held-out score and no accuracy_val is derived from it; the run's own val submissions carry the val figure.
